name: Outdoor Living
summary: Outdoor living construction and remodeling for patios, seating areas, exterior finishes, lighting, shade structures and entertainment spaces.

faqs.question: What can be included in an outdoor living project?
faqs.answer: Projects may include patios, shade structures, outdoor kitchens, lighting, fans, seating walls, masonry, exterior finishes and drainage improvements.

faqs.question: Can outdoor living areas be added to an existing patio?
faqs.answer: Yes. Existing spaces can often be expanded or upgraded after evaluating the slab, drainage, structure and utility needs.
